protocol.note: Sections 1-3 use original Step 1 checkpoints. Section 4 uses retrain checkpoints (step2_20260704). Section 9 uses mixed-stress validation checkpoints (step3_mixedstress_20260704). All evaluations fix the R backend to ksp_ff_k50_hops.

step2_retrain.note: Retrained from scratch using the same protocol as Step 1 to verify reproducibility.

step3_mixedstress.description: Retrained with mixed-stress validation: standard, medium, heavy stress levels evaluated at each checkpoint, best selected by max_blocking.
